workspace.text:

workspace.text:

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I checked all the slots where Elena and David are free against Priya and Marcus's calendars:

- Monday 11:00-12:00: Priya busy (Travel 11:00-11:30, Contract review 11:30-12:00)
- Tuesday 09:00-10:00: Priya busy (Board prep 09:00-09:30, Partner lunch 09:30-10:00)
- Wednesday 13:00-14:00: Priya busy (Client call 13:00-13:30, Client dinner prep 13:30-14:00)
- Thursday 09:30-10:00: Priya busy (09:30-10:00 marked as Busy)
- Thursday 14:30-15:30: Priya busy (Vendor meeting 14:30-15:00, Client dinner prep 15:00-15:30)
- Friday 15:00-16:00: Priya busy (Hiring panel 15:00-15:30, Contract review 15:30-16:00)

Unfortunately, none of the slots where Elena and David are free work for Priya and Marcus. 

Similarly, the slots where Priya and Marcus are free (Mon 9:00-10:00, Tue 13:00-14:00 & 16:30-17:00, Wed 15:00-16:00, Thu 9:00-9:30 & 10:00-10:30, Fri 11:00-12:00) don't appear in your list, meaning Elena or David are busy then.

It seems there may be no common 30-minute slot for all four partners. Can you double-check your analysis of Elena and David's calendars? Maybe we missed something, or perhaps there's a slot I overlooked in Priya/Marcus's calendars. Let me know your thoughts.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've carefully re-analyzed both sets of calendars. My analysis confirms there is no overlap between the slots where Elena & David are free and the slots where Priya & Marcus are free.

Elena & David are both free at:
- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

Priya & Marcus are both free at:
- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

None of these time ranges overlap. I've double-checked every slot against both calendars, and there is no 30-minute window where all four partners are simultaneously available next week.

I'm preparing to report this as infeasible. Please confirm you agree with this assessment.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: I've re-verified both sets of free times and I agree with your analysis. There is no 30-minute window next week where all four partners are simultaneously available. I'll report this as infeasible.
